name: DeployTemplate
title: Templates/Platform/Creation/DeployTemplate
summary: The deploy template page, a focused flow outside the console shell: the creation header with Back to Creation Center and the Start from a Template crumb, the template preview card naming the repository it clones from, then the step the flow is on with Browse Templates under it. Without a Git provider the step is the Connect a Git provider card; once one is connected it is the Deploy your project form, with the scope and the repository name with its privacy switch side by side over the template settings, and the Deploy button that stays disabled until every required setting is filled. Deploying hands the same column to the build logs (the DeploymentFlow template) and then to the success screen (the DeploySuccess template). Import from Git and Upload a Project reach the same page with the form trimmed to the repository or the uploaded files. Built from `GlobalHeader`, `Breadcrumb`, `Card`, `EmptyState`, `FieldSelect`, `Label`, `InputGroup`, `Switch`, `FieldText` and `Button`.
